Tamboli Industries Limited announces a significant milestone as its wholly owned subsidiary, Tamboli Castings Limited (TCL), is selected and qualified by a multibillion dollar Fortune 100 Global OEM in the Off-Highway equipments and advanced mobility solutions segments. Emerging successfully from a rigourous international selection proccess against leading precision component manufacturers across emerging markets, TCL has secured development orders for over 50 precision components under a long-term development and supply programme, positioning the company for deeper integration into global OEM manufacturing and supply chains.
